newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The candidates for portfolios in the government of Prime Minister-designate Victor Ciorbea are being heard on Tuesday by the joint standing commissions of the upper Senate house and the lower Chamber of Deputies.
Some of the candidates need to appear in front of several commissions. After the hearing, commissions are due to file a report with Ciorbea to state their approval or disapproval of the nomination.

* NATO foreign ministers met in Brussels for a two-day conference on the alliance's enlargement. They decided that a NATO summit expected to name the first candidates for new membership will be held in July 1997.
In July, NATO will invite some former East-bloc states for negotiations and to discuss ties within the Partnership for Peace scheme, NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana said.
* Two coal miners died and two others were seriously injured when a gallery in the Petrila mine, in the Jiu Valley coalfield, collapsed on Monday . -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
